name_input: Meghmani Dyes And Intermediates LLP; MEGHMANI DYES AND INTERMEDIATES LLP
court_cases: Multiple Indian court/tribunal matters found on Indian Kanoon (46 documents for the name, incl. predecessor entity Meghmani Dyes and Intermediates Ltd). Party role: predominantly PETITIONER/APPELLANT (taxpayer challenging authorities), i.e. tax and customs disputes, not criminal or fraud matters. Key records: (1) M/s Meghmani Dyes and Intermediates LLP vs C.C.E. Ahmedabad-I, CESTAT West Zonal Bench, order dated 28.08.2017 (excise/service tax); (2) M/s Meghmani Dyes and Intermediates vs Commissioner of Central Excise Ahmedabad-I, CESTAT, 20.02.2018; (3) Messrs Meghmani Dyes and Intermediates LLP vs Union of India, Gujarat HC, SCA 8297/2019, judgment 09.01.2020 (Bhargav D. Karia); (4) M/s Meghmani Dyes and Intermediates LLP vs Deputy Commissioner of Income Tax Circle 3(1)(1) Ahmedabad, Gujarat HC, SCA 24334/2022, judgment 06.05.2025; (5) M/s Meghmani Dyes and Intermediates LLP vs DCIT, Gujarat HC, SCA 2412/2022, 06.09.2022; (6) Chief Commissioner of Income Tax (OSD) vs Meghmani Dyes and Intermediates Ltd, Gujarat HC, 31.07.2020 (company as respondent); (7) Messrs Meghmani Dyes and Intermediates Ltd vs Union of India, Gujarat HC, SCA 12228/2014, 03.09.2014; (8) company applications O/COMP/385/2015 and O/COMA/284/2015, Gujarat HC, 23.12.2015 and 23.09.2015 (scheme/restructuring matters). Status: all appear disposed/orders issued; no criminal proceedings, no insolvency, no winding-up found. Per project rules these are not rejection grounds.
news_risk: No negative news, regulator action or adverse media found. Searches of Indian Kanoon for 'Meghmani' + Russia returned only unrelated anti-dumping matters (Nirma Ltd, Farmson Pharmaceuticals, India Paint Association, L&T) — no Meghmani party. Company media page (meghmaniglobal.com/media) contains only CSR/blood-donation and group announcements (e.g. Meghmani Renew Energy MoU with Odisha, 04.11.2026; Dr. Alok Das appointed MD & CEO of MREPL, 15.10.2026) — no enforcement, penalty or environmental prosecution items. Note: general web search engines were largely unavailable/returning irrelevant results during this check, so absence of negative news is based on Indian Kanoon + company site only and is not an exhaustive media sweep.
note: Sanctions exposure: NOT CONFIRMED either way. The OFAC Sanctions List Search tool is JavaScript-driven and returned no queryable results via direct HTTP fetch; UN/EU/UK consolidated lists and the BIS Entity List could not be queried in this session (search backend refused connections, Bing returned irrelevant results). No sanctions designation for Meghmani Dyes and Intermediates LLP was found in any accessible source, but this must be treated as 'not verified', not as a clean bill — recommend a manual re-run against OFAC SDN, UN Consolidated, EU FSF and UK OFSI lists. Credit rating: null — no public rating found; the entity is an LLP (unlisted), and the listed group vehicle Meghmani Organics Ltd is a separate legal entity whose rating must not be attributed to this LLP. RF/CIS supply evidence: null — no customs, B-L, court or media record of supplies to Russia or CIS found; the company states a customer base in 70+ countries (own website, meghmaniglobal.com/meghmani-dyes-and-intermediates-llp/) but that is a self-declaration, not evidence of any specific shipment. Court matters are tax/customs/restructuring disputes with the company mostly as petitioner — neutral note: 'есть сложности' (tax litigation), not a rejection ground. No criminal cases against owners identified. Identity/HS/shipment volumes deliberately not researched per role scope.
